People not only use our credential evaluation services in Miami FL to get into college, but, in some instances, to also obtain employment in the US.

By choosing American Education and Translation Services, you can expect professional, accurate translations accepted by all organizations, agencies and institutions. When requesting our international credential evaluation services in Miami FL, you will get:

3 Important Questions to Ask Before Choosing Credential Evaluations

Before you choose a company to provide your Miami foreign credential evaluation, you should ask a few questions. Here are some of the most important ones to keep in mind.

  • Is the evaluation formatted in a way the college or university can use?
  • Does the credential evaluation agency answer questions or address concerns in a timely manner?
  • Does the agency have extensive experience in providing Miami credential evaluation services?
